_doc: Video files in data/videos/ checked against ShuttleSet's frame_num with scripts/verify_alignment.py. Only aligned=true matches are used by the UI, local_run, training, and uploaded to S3. fps alone is not enough: CHOU's upload has the right fps but a different edit.

CHOU_Tien_Chen_Jonatan_CHRISTIE_Sudirman.note: Current YouTube upload is a different edit: 49.2 min long vs a 35.7 min annotated span; stroke frames land on venue, coach and close-up shots. Needs a time offset (or the original upload) before use.

CHOU_Tien_Chen_NG_Ka_Long_Angus_Sudirman.note: Different edit of the broadcast: stroke frames land on venue, crowd and close-up shots (second Sudirman Cup upload with this problem).

Viktor_AXELSEN _SHI_Yu_Qi_All_England_Op.note: Half the sampled stroke frames are low-angle close camera shots rather than the main broadcast view.
